Every model now records the production feature-set digest sha256:f135d8819346efa3c31e824541e6c68e4a71ef970ca64d839754e4804a5d7f06 and its consumed-versus-learned split, and all four stand on the same 7,933-race population, checked by digest. Headline figures unchanged: softmax -0.001087, softmax_offset -0.004533, probit +0.002018, probit_offset -0.004358. Two things were checked specifically because the sweep's first attempt got them wrong. The identity card reads five ensemble members, seeds 7, 17, 42, 123 and 256 -- the first sweep ran with probit_suite's one-seed default and published a one-member model, which the tie-out caught. And the paired-delta card is back at -0.012557 against softmax: writing a run identity for the first time had removed it, because the report had been deriving the diagnostic from its own table, and a canonical test caught that the report stopped naming its reference model at all.
